user.title: Econergy Cloud
user.description: Connect your Econergy account. A secure Econergy page will let you choose which homes to authorize. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE (no client secret).

select_home.title: Choose home
select_home.description: Select the Econergy home to link to this Home Assistant entry. You can add another entry for another authorized home.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Econergy
reauth_confirm.description: Your Econergy authorization must be renewed. Continue to open the Econergy consent page.

error.invalid_auth: The Econergy account did not authorize the connection.
error.cannot_connect: Could not validate Econergy API access: {detail}

abort.already_configured: This Econergy home is already configured.
abort.home_not_found: The selected home is no longer accessible.
abort.oauth_invalid_token: Econergy returned an invalid access token.
abort.refresh_token_missing: Econergy did not return a refresh token. The integration cannot guarantee automatic sign-in renewal.
abort.missing_scopes: Missing permissions: {scopes}. Reconnect and grant readonly and write.
abort.no_homes: No homes are accessible with this authorization.
abort.reauth_home_unavailable: The configured home is no longer authorized for this application.
abort.oauth_flow_expired: The sign-in flow expired. Start adding the integration again.
